meta.legende:
Two Pokémon walk into the Crystal Cave. Only one walks out. 💎

On paper, Typhlosion has the edge: fire melts steel. But Mega Excadrill can dig straight under the flames and hit back just as hard. I genuinely changed my mind three times watching this one.

So who's your pick? Drop a 🔥 for Typhlosion or a ⛏️ for Mega Excadrill, and tag the friend who's always wrong about these 😄

meta.titre: Typhlosion vs Mega Excadrill… this one went down to the wire 🔥⛏️
meta.youtube_description:
Honestly, I didn't see this ending coming.
Typhlosion's fire should melt Excadrill's steel… but a Mega Excadrill drilling through the ground is a nightmare for any fire type. Both of them can hit super effective, so it all comes down to who lands it first.

Before you watch the end, tell me in the comments who you're backing:
🔥 Typhlosion or ⛏️ Mega Excadrill?
